identified_disparities.description: Specific disparities supported by evidence, such as racial gaps in eviction rates or access to services.

systemic_exclusion_factors.description: The underlying systemic factors that contribute to these inequities, such as the digital divide or transportation barriers.

agency_name.description: The name of the agency, such as RRHA, OCWB, or GRCoC.

challenge_type.description: The category of the challenge (e.g., Intake Process, Referral Integrity, Waitlist Management).

specific_issue.description: A detailed description of the specific issue or breakdown at the agency.

evidence_source.description: The source of evidence for this issue, such as a report, lawsuit, or user testimony.

agency_specific_challenges.description: Detailed evidence of specific breakdowns and user pain points at key Richmond agencies, including the Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority (RRHA), the Office of Community Wealth Building (OCWB), and the Greater Richmond Continuum of Care (GRCoC).

connection_line_issues.description: Specific problems with the Homeless Connection Line, such as long wait times, voicemail backlogs, or limited hours.

shelter_access_barriers.description: Challenges in accessing emergency shelters, including high turn-away rates and lack of capacity.

coordinated_entry_flaws.description: Systemic issues within the Coordinated Entry process, such as ineffective prioritization or referrals that lead to dead ends.

transportation_barriers.description: Challenges related to transportation, including the cost and reliability of public transit (GRTC) to access services.

digital_divide_issues.description: Problems related to the digital divide, such as the inability to access online-only applications or navigate complex websites.

time_and_cost_burden.description: The overall burden of time and out-of-pocket costs (e.g., for transportation, childcare) required to navigate the system.

city_name.description: The name of the comparable city (e.g., Baltimore, Louisville).

observed_challenge.description: The similar systemic challenge observed in that city, such as issues with their coordinated entry system.

relevance_to_richmond.description: How the challenge in the comparable city provides context or validation for the issues found in Richmond.
